comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
This `TreeListView.MakeListViewItem` index crash (a race in the virtual list when the tree model changes during a redraw) was fixed after your build. You're on **1.81.0-beta.4 (build 3411)**; the guard for this exact `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` landed in builds after that (issues #52 / #56) and is in every current nightly.

Please update to the latest nightly and it should be gone: https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly

If you can still reproduce it on a current build,...
